provenance.note: Upper bound only. Expert-miss stream priced at 20.6 ms of a ~56 ms decode round (33-37%) in the 2026-10-09 lever audit; that miss count (135/round) and the 11.5 GB/s staging rate are sensitivity assumptions, not B70 counters. Two-card --layer-split holds all 24,576 IQ3_XXS experts (42.9 GB) in 64 GB VRAM, so the miss term goes to ~0 (local_speedup 100 stands for removal). Ignores the per-round hidden-state handoff between cards and any loss of copy/compute overlap. The deciding probe must read Strata's miss counters per cell.

Layer-split boundary cost per decode round: one hidden-state block (assumed <=5 tokens x 2048 hidden x fp32 = 40 KB) crosses the card boundary forward, plus a token handback; 30 us per crossing is an assumed host-staged latency class, RL-059 measured 11.1-11.9 GB/s copy bandwidth only. Strata's actual hidden size and transport (P2P vs host-staged) must be read from the engine log.
